svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of one contact hole beside a transistor gate, one above the other. Before the step a thin purple film lines the hole and covers the flat top. After it a thin teal disc lies under that film at the bottom of the hole, sunk into the top of the doped silicon; nothing else changes.
svg.desc: Two enlarged cross-sections of one contact hole beside a transistor gate, one above the other. Before the step a thin purple film lines the hole and covers the flat top. After it a thin teal disc lies under that film at the bottom of the hole, sunk into the top of the doped silicon; nothing else changes.
svg.text: Before: the liner in the hole (step 097)
A rapid anneal reacts the titanium with
the silicon at the bottom of every hole.
After: a silicide disc at the bottom of the hole
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
